Description and metadata

Outcome

As Juan, I want to request Propose or eligible Refine and publish a comment from an issue workspace, then follow the exact source outcome without routinely editing GitHub labels or leaving SoFa.

Owner-authorized dependency delivery for #51/#52/#57/#88. Development identity #49 is merged; the #50 reader and source-only observations are implemented with acceptance limits. Concrete plan: https://github.com/juangcarmona/sofa/pull/112. Independent Luna High technical planning review accepted all eleven dimensions at d40b364d7ace70bd65edb439e99cd675f2eee2f4. The owner accepted PR #112, ADR-0008 and the protected journal design on 2026-11-08. Lighthouse CLI 0.12.61 / SDLC 0.22.0 is published and its official source contract is merged through PR #115. The owner confirmed updated development App permissions and installation consent. Actual connected App-user effects and the final delivery gates remain to be demonstrated. #58 owns production readiness; node-home provisioning does not block development.

Existing evidence and scope split

Preserve #47 and its reports:

Refinement: https://github.com/juangcarmona/sofa/issues/47#issuecomment-6410966096 — run 40287921209.
Blocked proposal: https://github.com/juangcarmona/sofa/issues/47#issuecomment-6412062941 — run 40294746514.

Its body and relevant owner conversation participate in the task digest. This story does not replace the refinement or inherit its Ready verdict. #47 retains Refine and the shared submission foundation; #50 owns the issue read model; this story reuses both. Resolve identity and correlation through linked work and recheck evidence before resuming #47's proposal. No labels or later-stage authority are changed by this backlog preparation.

Acceptance Criteria
From #50's real issue context, display recommended and other supported actions with a brief effect and acting GitHub identity. Shared Lighthouse eligibility uses current permissions, capability version, evidence, reservations and source state. Unavailable actions have specific explanations.
Recheck session, source authority and relevant state on the server before submission; the repository rechecks at admission. Changed state produces an explanation and no stale dispatch.
Request Propose after valid refinement and offer Refine when permitted. Propose submission does not imply admission, an existing proposal, approval or implementation authority.
Persist command intent and source receipts; repeated clicks, reconnects, competing tabs and retries do not create duplicate work. Conflicting payloads under one request identity are rejected.
Use the exact source run receipt and the shared request identity. A timeout or process restart around dispatch remains uncertain until reconciled. Never choose a recent matching run or silently resend.
Show request, source admission/rejection, queued/running state, human wait and published stage outcome separately. A completed workflow with a blocked result is not success. The owner can read results and related proposal/PR/check evidence inside SoFa.
Publish comments attributed to the verified GitHub user with a confirmed source comment ID or an explicit uncertain result. Reconcile uncertain posts before retry.
Ordinary comments do not request continuation, including on needs-info issues. Reply-and-continue is a separate explicit supported action bound to the pending question and current grant. Do not modify labels to work around shared policy.
Allow ordinary comments during active work with a pre-submit explanation when source input freshness will be invalidated. Show the subsequent source consequence without automatically requesting another execution.
Keep issue state, lifecycle stage, command, execution, reservation and human wait separate. Preserve triage → refine → propose → implement → integrate → review.
Demonstrate the full first-delivery journey on a real test issue from desktop and a phone over LAN/VPN: authenticated reading, authorized/denied actions, changed state, duplicates, lost responses, exact correlation, comment behavior and visible result. Closing SoFa does not stop admitted work.
Dependencies and product traceability
#49: Keycloak container in Aspire for development, configured external production Keycloak on node-home, and separate GitHub user authorization. Provider direction is decided.
#50: issue description, paginated conversation and source evidence.
#47: Refine and shared command submission foundation; preserve its existing evidence.
https://github.com/juangcarmona/lighthouse/issues/119: versioned action decisions, source request receipts/deduplication and explicit comment continuation. Consume and verify a compatible release; do not copy its policy into SoFa.
#45 / PR #46: implemented read-only observation baseline.
CHG-AUTHENTICATED-OPERATIONS-001: UC-OPERATE-ISSUE, FR-AUTHORIZED-ENTRY, FR-ISSUE-CONTEXT, FR-ISSUE-CONVERSATION, BR-EXPLICIT-WORK-COMMANDS, QR-MOBILE-OPERATIONS, QR-EXECUTION-SECURITY and CON-TRUSTED-LAN.
ADR-0006 remains accepted. Canonical arc42 views and the development decisions in merged #49 explain the implemented identity boundary. ADR-0008 and its protected SQLite/receipt design in #112 were accepted by the owner before implementation. The former local draft branch is historical.
Verification and boundaries

Use deterministic adapter/security tests plus actual connected App-user source and responsive/keyboard evidence. The owner waived physical-phone rehearsal; do not request it again or claim it ran. Current GitHub dispatch documentation provides an exact run ID in a successful response; verify the selected API version and actual user-token behavior. That receipt alone does not resolve a lost response, source duplication or comment continuation.

The authenticated-operations Product Change was applied and accepted through #82. The delivery conversation authorizes necessary technical dependency work and merges; this issue does not itself grant stage continuation, product/security decisions or protected approvals. The accepted persistent journal and explicit handlers are implemented in #112; exact-head hosted checks and actual connected-user qualification remain separate. No scheduler, worker allocation, public hosting or household administration is introduced. Production secrets/backup/deployment evidence belongs to #58 and infra.homelab; it does not prevent local functional development.

Next increment: #51 intervention inbox, #52 discovery/project views and #53 configuration deviations. Later horizon: #54 explainable health, #55 idea promotion, #56 delivery actions/evidence and #57 resource visibility. These are tracked work, not prerequisites for this story.
